# BlinQ 6.7.0 — Admin + public polish

- Visible header search removed; hidden runtime hook kept for compatibility.
- Prime Picks are globally disabled by default in Daily Picks and dashboard/navigation.
- Admin opens on Accounts and tabs are reordered/renamed for clearer operations.
- Daily Offer admin now has a global ON/OFF switch per category plus per-level rules.
- Tournament provider logos remain preferred; missing/failed logos get a truthful generic tier badge (ATP/WTA/CH/ITF + level when known).
- Daily table typography, tournament logos and player avatars are slightly larger for readability.
- Prediction/model logic is unchanged.
